It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that pursuant to award dated 05/11/2020 passed with regard to the property in which the petitioner claims interest, the respondent No.5 approached the Sub-Divisional Officer and sought adjudication of the dispute with regard to entitlement of compensation.
It is urged that such dispute ought to have been filed under Section 76 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transperency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
